<h1>TR-8 Accent</h1>

## Purpose

Edit the TR-8's per-step **accent intensity** using 8 row-selected
levels (row 1 = no accent, row 8 = full accent). Same gesture model as
the step velocity/duty views, targeting the global `tr8_accent` array.

## Interaction

Columns are steps (LHS = 1–8, RHS = 9–16), rows are values (row 1 bottom =
no accent … row 8 top = full accent). Each step lights a **single pad** at
the height of its stored value, not a bar filled from the bottom; a
positioner colour marks the playing step, and columns whose step carries a
trig anywhere in the kit are shaded slate behind the contour. Pressing a pad
writes that row's accent instantly. No modifier needed.

## Shortcuts

| Gesture | Where | Action | Modifiers |
|---|---|---|---|
| Press | LP grid | Set the step (column) to the pressed row's accent | none |
| SHIFT + MUTE + press row R | LP grid | **Reset**: all 16 steps → accent of row R | shift+mute |
| SHIFT + MUTE + press | LP LHS col 9 | **Reset**: all 16 steps → `5` (row 6) | shift+mute |
| SHIFT + SOLO + press row R | LP grid | **Randomise**: all 16 steps gaussian around row R (clamped to rows 1–8) | shift+solo |
| SHIFT + SOLO + press | LP LHS col 9 | **Randomise**: all 16 steps uniform random across values 0–7 | shift+solo |
